test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Despite of technological innovations and powerful analytical tools, nothing is happening.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Despite of technological innovations'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part of the given sentence that has an error in it is:* "Despite of technological innovations"*
 
• The correct phrase is* "Despite technological innovations".*
 
• The word **"despite"** is a preposition used to introduce a fact that is in sharp contrast with another fact.
 
• It does not require the use of **"of"** following it.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *"Despite technological innovations and powerful analytical tools, nothing is happening."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are not errors:
 
 
• **"And powerful analytical tools,"** is grammatically correct. It is part of the series of phrases that despite their presence, "nothing is happening".
 
• **"Nothing is happening."** is also correct. It is a complete sentence that follows the setup created by the first part of the sentence.
